section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1977
title: 31 ## Sex: During 1977, 59.0 per cent of the total suicides were committed by males and 41.0 per cent by females. A similar pattern was noticed in the 'Male' and 'Female' ratio during the year 1976. The 'Male' and 'Female' ratio in suicides for States was also the same as for the country as a whole. The percentage of male involvement in 14 States, 6 Union Territories and 3 Metropolitan Cities was higher than the all-India average. The details are presented in Table-7.
